font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: normal;\"\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of\u0026nbsp; \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E55\/M ,motor mechanic, was brought to casualty on 4.8.2021 with complaints of h\/o decreased urine output\u0026nbsp; since 3 days.\u003C\/span\u003E\n\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003EHOPI:- Patient was apparently asymptomatic till 1997 when he had fall from a current pole after which he had injury to left upperlimb , lowerlimb and lowerback for which he started using painkillers daily till 1 month back.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003EFrom last 10 yrs patient started experiencing B\/L knee pain which was prominent in the mornings.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003E 6 years back\u0026nbsp; he started developing pedal edema in B\/L lowerlimbs ,pitting type extending upto both the knees.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003EPatient also gives h\/o pain in B\/L elbow joints and small joints in the both the hands associated with morning stiffness in the joints since 5 years.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.2px;\"\u003EAlthough this didnot disable him from doing his routine. His work started to get effected\u0026nbsp; 1 year back when pain had increased in intensity,\u0026nbsp; it limited him to forego his routine and stay at home.He confined himself to household work.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003EPatient gives h\/o trauma 1 month back to right lowerlimb at the ankle due to bike accident which got infected for which he was prescribed some antibiotics.\u0026nbsp; The wound didnot subside even after taking antibiotics.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003E15 days ago i.e. on 20.7.2021 he developed sudden onset SOB for which he was taken to hospital there he was\u0026nbsp; given oxygen support for his SOB. There the doctors told him that his serum creatinine levels are elevated and advised him dialysis.\u0026nbsp; On 26.7.2021 while patient is being prepared for cvp line he suffered from cardiac arrest and was resuscitated.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003EHis 1st dialysis was done\u0026nbsp; on 26.7.2021 . \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003EAnd on 26th his for his knee joints swelling doctors performed a procedure and drained 150ml of serosanguinous fluid from each of the knee joints. And again they performed same procedure on 30.7.2021 and drained 80ml fluid from right knee joint and 50ml from left knee joint.From then he underwent dilaysis for 6 times (6th dialysis was done on 2.8.2021).\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 15px;\"\u003EAfter his 6th dialysis patient was taken home. BD\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIv 25%Dextrose. 100 ml BD\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIv fluids : NS 40 ml \/hr.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EQUESTION 5\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETesting scholarship competency in logging reflective observations on your concrete experiences of this last month write an essay for 10 marks on the above topic:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EWe have started our internship program on 2nd June, due to the covid pandemic we have been struck in our homes for the last 1 year , and completed our final year in online, because of which we lost the valuable 1 year of practical classes in which we could learnt something. With all these fears of not seeing patients for one year and suddenly coming in touch with patients was quite exciting and with all new hopes we started our internship and posted in the general medicine department in which we are having a lot of exposure to different kinds of patients, we have had experiences of seeing patients suffering and all the efforts done by PG's and us to save them arose a quite doctor in me. I have experienced both the feelings of being successful in saving the patient which filled me with immense happiness and failure which filled me with grief. The most important thing then I realised was the world was grey and not black and white. I understood the feeling of being a doctor. Our HOD sir in every day rounds explained about each and every case and asked me to film it and asked to know about every patient, in the process of I got the valuable information from sir and which ignited a sense of learning in me. It helped me understand about a lot of topics which I couldn't understand by reading books, and the interactive sessions in the afternoon also helped me a lot to learn how to present cases and understood how discussion helps in solving the cases. I will also learn to ask questions in which I am lacking and try to be a good and active member of medical team. I thank general medicine department for the opportunity.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/budigammadhumithagm.blogspot.com\/feeds\/5879487688454000170\/comments\/default","title":"Post Comments"},{"rel":"replies","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/budigammadhumithagm.blogspot.com\/2021\/07\/july-bimonthly-assessment.html#comment-form","title":"0 Comments"},{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/3745895214024784355\/posts\/default\/5879487688454000170"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/3745895214024784355\/posts\/default\/5879487688454000170"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/budigammadhumithagm.blogspot.com\/2021\/07\/july-bimonthly-assessment.html","title":"JULY BIMONTHLY ASSESSMENT "}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"BUDIGAM MADHUMITHA"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/04540248530936705880"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"16","height":"16","src":"https:\/\/img1.blogblog.com\/img\/b16-rounded.gif"}}],"thr$total":{"$t":"0"}}]}}
